title: Generalizable Cross-modality Medical Image Segmentation via Style Augmentation and Dual Normalization
mechanism: Separate BN for source-similar and source-dissimilar style augmentations; test-time style-distance selection of the BN path.
evidence: Outperforms DG methods on BraTS, cross-modality cardiac and abdominal (abstract).
adaptation: BN set A for label-safe augmentation, BN set B for GIN/BigAug-strong augmentation; route each cell by style distance.
min_experiment: PF+DN vs PF+GIN-IPA; E1 relF1@2; kill if < +0.02.
prior_overlap: Partial: separate BN used in SSL runs for another purpose; per-panel BN adaptation failed. Style-routed dual BN untested.
